title: Precision Platformer
summary: Tight, low-latency, responsive control with a short, snappy jump and explicit forgiveness windows.

runSpeed.whyItMatters: Fast enough to clear precise gaps without feeling sluggish; not so fast it overshoots.
runSpeed.suggestion: Raise/lower the controller's max horizontal speed toward 9 u/s.

runAcceleration.whyItMatters: Near-instant ground acceleration is the signature of precision control.
runAcceleration.suggestion: Increase ground acceleration so the player reaches top speed in ~0.1s.

runDeceleration.whyItMatters: Quick stop lets the player line up pixel-perfect landings.
runDeceleration.suggestion: Raise ground friction/deceleration so the player halts almost immediately on release.

jumpApex.whyItMatters: A controlled, repeatable apex height the player can internalize.
jumpApex.suggestion: Tune jump impulse and gravity together to hit a 3u apex.

timeToApex.whyItMatters: A short rise keeps the jump feeling responsive rather than floaty.
timeToApex.suggestion: Tune jump impulse and rise gravity so the apex is reached in ~0.28s.

shortHopApex.whyItMatters: A meaningful jump-cut gives the player fine vertical control.
shortHopApex.suggestion: Apply a jump-cut multiplier on button release so a tap peaks near 1.1u.

fallGravityMultiplier.whyItMatters: A heavier fall than rise makes the jump land crisply.
fallGravityMultiplier.suggestion: Set fall gravity to ~1.6x rise gravity.

coyoteTime.whyItMatters: A small explicit grace window absorbs late jump presses off ledges.
coyoteTime.suggestion: Add/clamp a coyote-time window of ~0.1s after leaving the ground.

jumpBuffer.whyItMatters: Buffering an early press makes landing-then-jumping feel instant.
jumpBuffer.suggestion: Buffer a jump press for ~0.1s before grounding.

dashDistance.whyItMatters: A fixed, learnable dash distance is core to precision traversal.
dashDistance.suggestion: Tune dash speed×duration so the dash covers ~4u.

dashTime.whyItMatters: A short dash keeps control tight and the window readable.

dashCooldown.whyItMatters: A brief cooldown gates dash spam without breaking flow.
dashCooldown.suggestion: Gate the next dash by ~0.2s (or until grounded).
